verdict.rationale: Spline ships a dedicated MCP Server (bundled in desktop app) that lets Claude, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Antigravity and ChatGPT drive the live editor to create/modify designs, plus a write-capable Code API for programmatic scene manipulation and webhooks/Real-time API for external event-driven updates. This goes beyond read-only access into genuine programmatic creation/modification. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the MCP server's write actions and no public OpenAPI spec was found (openapi probe 404s), so full API surface is only documented, not independently verified.
